literal_meaning: লাভের গাঁট বা তালিকা (profit's knot or tally)
figurative_meaning_en: Matter of profit or beneficial aspect
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় সবসময় লাভের গাঁতি খুঁজে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: In business, always look for the profitable side.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali trading practices where merchants used knots (গাঁতি) on strings to tally goods and profits, symbolizing the countable gains in commerce.
note: Reflects pragmatic Bengali worldview on opportunities.
